sources: Prop masses are start values chosen for the app (user can edit kg in the player), approximate start value, not verified against the original; kg is the total for the load point (hands = split over both hands).
note: toward/track are directions of the force the load applies to the body (y up, z body-forward); the engine normalises them. handle toward is the default (row); towardByVariant overrides it by exercise/variant (pulley direction differs per exercise). legpress track: force on the feet along the torso axis toward the body, for a back reclined 35 degrees off vertical. Plan section 2b.3 lists legpress as a prop; no current variant uses it (squat/legpress uses reclineBack and reclineSeat), so it is kept for the library.
